subject: Request: short customer quote & logo use for AWS co-sell badge
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.inference.com>
To: Emily Park <emily.park@lumenwave.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short customer quote & logo use for AWS co-sell badge

Hi Emily,

Hope you're doing well — enjoyed the call last week. We're preparing the final materials to submit Redwood's listing for the AWS co-sell badge and want to include a short customer quote and your logo on the Marketplace listing and related co-sell collateral.

Quick ask: would LumenWave be willing to provide a 1-2 sentence blurb we can use as a testimonial, and confirm permission to use the LumenWave logo for the AWS listing and co-sell badge? Example language we sometimes use: "Redwood Inference reduced our inference costs while improving latency, letting us ship product improvements faster." No need to use that exactly — anything short you prefer is great.

I've attached a draft case study (lumenwave_case_study_draft.pdf) so you can see context. If it helps, suggested quote below — feel free to edit: "Redwood's inference platform cut our inference costs by ~50% while improving 95th percentile latency, enabling faster feature delivery."

If this is OK, would you also loop in legal for a quick permission (logo + testimonial use limited to Marketplace/co-sell materials)? Ideally we'd like sign-off within a week so we can meet the marketplace submission window.

Thanks — excited to get LumenWave featured.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: lumenwave_case_study_draft.pdf

From: Emily Park <emily.park@lumenwave.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>, LumenWave Legal <legal@lumenwave.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2026 13:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short customer quote & logo use for AWS co-sell badge

Hi Rafael — thanks for the note and the draft. Happy to help, and we like the direction.

Proposed short quote (you can use this as-is):
"Redwood's inference platform reduced our serving costs by 48% and improved 95th percentile latency — it let our team ship higher-quality features faster."

You have permission to use the LumenWave logo and the quote for the AWS Marketplace listing and the co-sell badge, subject to a quick legal sign-off (looping legal here). One small edit request on the draft case study: in the results section please change "Q3 launch" to "Q2 launch" to match our internal timeline.

Copying our legal team to confirm the permissions — Sarah or someone from legal will reply with any required wording or limits.

Thanks,
Emily
Director of Product, LumenWave
emily.park@lumenwave.com

Subject: Fwd: Request: short customer quote & logo use for AWS co-sell badge

Hi Sarah / LumenWave Legal team,

Forwarding Emily's note and the proposed testimonial. Emily has indicated verbal approval; could you confirm in writing that LumenWave grants Redwood permission to use: (1) the short testimonial below, and (2) the LumenWave logo on Redwood's AWS Marketplace listing and co-sell badge?

Proposed testimonial: "Redwood's inference platform reduced our serving costs by 48% and improved 95th percentile latency — it let our team ship higher-quality features faster."

I've attached the case study draft for context. Please let us know if you need any edits to the quote wording or a formal signature on a permission document. We can accommodate any brand requirements.

Appreciate a quick turnaround — AWS submission window opens next week.

Thanks,
Rafael
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: lumenwave_case_study_draft.pdf

From: Sarah Kim <legal@lumenwave.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.inference.com>, Emily Park <emily.park@lumenwave.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2026 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: short customer quote & logo use for AWS co-sell badge

Hello Rafael / team,

LumenWave grants permission to use the testimonial text provided and the LumenWave logo on Redwood Inference's AWS Marketplace listing and co-sell materials, subject to the following limited conditions:

- Usage limited to AWS Marketplace listing, co-sell badge, Redwood marketing related to the listing, and in-product Marketplace tiles only.
- No sublicensing of the logo or quote to third parties beyond the Marketplace/co-sell program.
- Please include the following attribution line on the listing: "LumenWave (customer)" and link to https://www.lumenwave.com/terms and our privacy policy where required.

Attached is a signed permission memo: LumenWave_Marketplace_Permission_Sep3_2026.pdf. We also request the small edit Emily mentioned ("Q2 launch" in the case study).

If you can send a final copy of the listing text before publishing, we'll do a quick review (24-hour turnaround).

Regards,
Sarah Kim
Senior Counsel, LumenWave
legal@lumenwave.com

Attachments: LumenWave_Marketplace_Permission_Sep3_2026.pdf

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.inference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sun, 5 Sep 2026 09:00:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Request: short customer quote & logo use for AWS co-sell badge — Final permissions received

Quick update — LumenWave legal (Sarah) sent signed permission this afternoon and approved the exact quote Emily provided. Attached permission memo is in our Drive (linked below). Two small action items before we publish:

1) Monica — can you prepare the final case study PDF with Emily's Q2 edit and upload both the case study and permission memo to the AWS listing package? Link: https://drive.google.com/lumenwave-case-study-draft

2) Laura — once Monica uploads the assets, I'll prepare the Marketplace listing copy. Please do a final review on the copy (Sarah asked for a 24-hour review window).

I'll queue the Marketplace submission for Tuesday to hit the co-sell deadline. Thanks everyone for the fast turnaround.

Best,
Rafael
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.inference.com

(attachments: LumenWave_Marketplace_Permission_Sep3_2026.pdf — uploaded to Drive)
